DECAL_INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS
READ THE FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS THROUGH COMPLETELY AT LEAST ONCE BEFORE ATTEMPTING TO
INSTALL THE DECAL(S) THEY CONCERN! !

THE DECAL(S) ARE COMPOSED OF THREE (3) PARTS: 1)A HEAVY WAXED RACKING SHEET WHICH COVERS THE STICKY SIDE OF THE DECAL, 2) THE DECAL ITSFLF, AND 3)A THIN MASKING SHEET WHICH 1S ON THE FRONT SIDE OF THE MECAL TO PROTECT IT AND TO AID IN ITS INSTALLATION.

1 BE SURE THE AREA WHERE YOU ARE GOING TO APPLY THE DECAL IS CLEAN AND FREE OF ALL DIRT, GREASE, AND GRIME.
2. USING ANY SPRAY-ON GLASS CLEANER, THOROUGHLY WET DOWN THE AREA WHERE YOU INTEND TO PLT THE DECAL.

3. REMOVE THE HEAVY WAXED BACKING SHEET FROM THE DECAL RY POSITIONING IT FACE UP ON A FLAT SURFACE; GOING TO ANY CORNER; AND RENDING THIS CORNER UP SLIGHTLY TO SEPARATE THE DECAL AND THIN MASKING SHEET FROM THE HEAVY WAXED BACKING SHEET.
4, SLOWLY AND CAREFULLY PEEL THE HEAVY WAXED BACKING SHEET AWAY FROM THE DECAL AND MASKING SHEET.
5. PLACE THE DECAL ON THE GAME CARINET OVER THE WET GLASS CLEANER YOU JUST APPLIED. (THIS WILL ALLOW A SMALL AMOUNT OF FINAL POSITIONING TO BE DONE AFTER THE DECAL 1S APPLIED TO THE GAME CABINET.)
6. SMOOTH THE DECAL.
7. ALLOW THE DECAL TO RECOME FIRMLY AFFIXED TO THE GAME BEFORE PROCEEDING TO THE NEXT STEP.

8. REMOVE THE THIN MASKING SHEET FROM THE DECAL AT THIS TIME RY MOISTENING IT WITH A WET CLOTH OR SPONGE. RUA WITH FINGER TIPS (NOT NAILS) FROM A CORNER EDGE TOWARD ITS CEN- TER. PEEL THE THIN MASKING SHEET BACK OVER ITSELF TO REMOVE IT. DO NOT PULL IT STRAIGHT AWAY FROM THE CABINET.
